card.name: Last word inside quoted glosses
card.fires_on: The final word or word piece inside a quoted, parenthesized gloss or translation, just before the closing quote mark and bracket. It is typical of etymology notes, local plant names and cited titles.

modes.label: Translation glosses
modes.description: Last word of a quoted meaning or translation of a foreign term.

modes.label: Gene or place name glosses
modes.description: Last word of a quoted full name or translation after a gene symbol or place name.

modes.label: Local plant names
modes.description: Final piece of a quoted common name after a Latin species name.

card.writes: It promotes odd symbol pieces and suppresses sentence-ending punctuation after a closing bracket, so the quote is not ended yet.
card.plain: It fires on the last word of a short quoted explanation in brackets, right before the quote closes.
